content:
Impl of the approved plan (docs/phases/sonicgrid-result-models.md). Branch phase-13/sonicgrid-result-models, UNCOMMITTED working tree on base 3f82ffc (Jack commits on request; review with git diff).

Changed:
- src/bugalizer/sync/results.py: MODEL_MAX=120; _model_label (provider prefixed only when llm_model does not already start with '<provider>/', cut to 120, null on empty/missing model); _fix_analysis (newest completed 'fix' analysis with created_at <= proposals[0].created_at, never analysis_id); build_payload admin gains triageModel / localizationModel / fixModel from the same triage/localization rows and newest proposal already used for the other fields.
- tests/test_triage_sync.py: fake sonicgrid strict check now allows ADMIN_OPTIONAL (1-120 chars or null, still rejects unknown keys). New: test_model_label_rules (7 cases: prefixed not doubled, unprefixed, passthrough both forms, null provider, null/empty model), test_model_label_is_cut_to_the_contract_limit, test_model_fields_are_null_without_the_analyses (incl. failed triage), test_fix_model_is_the_fix_that_made_the_newest_proposal (newer failed fix + newer no-proposal fix ignored, older proposal names its own fix, analysis_id points at localization, no fix before proposal -> null), test_the_push_carries_the_models (through the fake end to end), test_a_result_pushed_before_b5_repushes_once_and_is_applied (pre-B5 payload pushed, upgraded service re-pushes with higher revision and is applied, third tick sends nothing).
- Docs: CLAUDE.md Phase 13 line, roadmap status, phase doc status. No schema/migration/UI change.

Verified: full suite 530 passed (uv run pytest, working tree on 3f82ffc + this diff); ruff clean on both changed files. Not verified: real sonicgrid acceptance (BOWIE, after sonicgrid #639 is confirmed in production - deploy gate retained per your plan note).

Approved. Reviewed the submitted uncommitted diff on base 3f82ffc against the approved plan. Model labels preserve existing provider prefixes, handle missing metadata, and respect the 120-character limit. Triage/localization attribution uses the existing selected rows, and fix attribution selects the completed fix analysis preceding the displayed proposal rather than its localization analysis_id. The fake retains strict unknown-key rejection while accepting the three optional fields; tests cover normalization, nulls, truncation, proposal-specific attribution despite later failed/orphan fix analyses, end-to-end payloads, and one applied upgrade re-push followed by no further push. Scope is limited to payload construction, tests, and documentation. Accepted the lead's recorded full suite (530 passed) and ruff result for this working tree under the one-run rule; did not rerun the suite. Reviewer git diff --check passed. Production acceptance remains pending, and the documented requirement to deploy sonicgrid #639 to production before BOWIE rollout remains in force. No commit, merge, or deployment performed.
